# Architecture

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### Style

Flat layered vanilla-JS module tree — `core/` (pure domain logic) → `ui/` (DOM rendering/orchestration class) → `integrations/` (external I/O clients) — wired together by a single `index.js` entrypoint; no framework, no DI container, no routing (`src/` layout, `src/index.js`).

### Directory layout

```
src/
  core/               # pure functions: no DOM, no fetch, no side effects
    context.js          # global/product context detection, traffic-origin (UTM/referrer) resolution
    payload.js           # builds the lead payload object + shape validator
    phone.js              # BR phone digit normalization/formatting/validation
    validation.js          # form validation (name, phone, LGPD, honeypot, subject)
    whatsapp.js             # wa.me URL + message text builder
  ui/                 # DOM-touching layer
    widget.js            # LeadWidget class: mount, open/close, submit orchestration
    template.js            # HTML string templates + createElementFromHtml helper
  integrations/       # external I/O clients
    gtm.js              # window.dataLayer push
    webhook.js            # fetch POST to merchant webhookUrl with AbortController timeout
  config.js           # DEFAULT_CONFIG + createConfig(overrides) factory
  index.js            # initWhatsAppLeadWidget/init — wires config → LeadWidget → mount
  snippet.html        # embeddable product-trigger markup example (Twig placeholders)
  styles.css           # widget styles, imported by index.js
tests/
  unit/               # vitest, jsdom env, mirrors src/core + integrations
  integration/         # Playwright specs against the built dev server (index.html)
docs/                 # PRD.md, quickstart.md (hand-authored project docs)
index.html            # Vite dev/demo page (loads src/index.js, calls init())
vite.config.js        # Vite IIFE library build (window.WhatsAppLeadWidget)
wrangler.jsonc        # Cloudflare Pages/Workers static asset deploy (SPA fallback)
```

### Layer responsibilities

| Layer | Owns | Does NOT own |
|---|---|---|
| `core/` | Validation rules, phone normalization, payload/message shaping, context/origin detection — pure, framework-free functions (`src/core/*.js`) | DOM access, network calls, event binding |
| `ui/` | DOM mount/unmount, event binding, form state, panel open/close, submit orchestration (calls into `core/` and `integrations/`) (`src/ui/widget.js`) | Payload shape rules, phone validation logic, network retry/timeout policy |
| `integrations/` | External I/O: `fetch` to webhook with timeout/abort, `window.dataLayer` push (`src/integrations/webhook.js`, `src/integrations/gtm.js`) | Form validation, payload construction |
| `config.js` | Default values and per-instance override merging (`createConfig`) | Behavior — consumed by `ui/` and `core/`, does not call them |
| `index.js` | Entrypoint wiring: config → `LeadWidget` → mount → attach product triggers | Business rules |

### External integration points

| System | Client/config | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Merchant webhook | `src/integrations/webhook.js:postLead(webhookUrl, payload, {fetchImpl, timeoutMs})` | `fetch` with `AbortController`, default 3000ms timeout (`config.webhookTimeoutMs`); `Content-Type: text/plain` to dodge CORS preflight; missing URL or non-function `fetchImpl` short-circuits to `HANDLED_FAILURE` without throwing |
| Google Tag Manager | `src/integrations/gtm.js:pushGtmEvent(win, eventName, data)` | No-op (`return false`) when `win.dataLayer` is absent or not an array — never throws if GTM isn't installed |
| WhatsApp (`wa.me`) | `src/core/whatsapp.js:buildWhatsappUrl` | Plain `https://wa.me/<digits>?text=<encoded message>` link, no API/SDK |
| Cloudflare Pages/Workers | `wrangler.jsonc` | Static asset host for the built `dist/` bundle; not called at runtime by the widget |

### Macro flow: Lead submission (not async messaging — synchronous request/response chain)

No message queue/broker is present (`digest.async.present: false`); the closest "flow" is the request/response chain from submit to redirect, shown below.

```
[visitor click] --> LeadWidget.submit()
                       |
                       v
              validateLeadForm() --fail--> showErrors() [terminal]
                       | pass
                       v
              buildLeadPayload()
                       |
                       v
              postLead(webhookUrl, payload)  --3s timeout/AbortController-->  HANDLED_FAILURE (non-blocking)
                       |
                       v (always, regardless of webhook outcome)
              pushGtmEvent(completeEventName)
                       |
                       v
              buildWhatsappUrl() --> window.open(url) OR onRedirect(url) [terminal]
```
